mission: Inside the breach zone, each character's response reveals their truth. Sera's hands clench, jaw set. Kael folds into himself. Torin relaxes — and smiles. The first real warning lands on a group that had eleven chapters to prepare for it.
why_now: The de-structured zone strips performance off everyone in it. Each character's honest register surfaces when the Force can no longer mediate, and Torin's register is the one the reader needs to see now.
conflict: Sera fights to hold discipline. Kael retreats into survival. Desh reports environmental data the way he always reports environmental data. Torin's Force presence stops being heavy. He smiles with recognition, not fear, and the smile is the answer to fifteen chapters' worth of questions.
turning_point: Torin smiles. In the place where the Force is broken, where everyone else is holding themselves together, Torin Hal looks at peace. Ben sees Jacen in the moments before the worst decisions — the certainty, the calm — and does not yet say the name aloud.
opening_hook: Inside the de-structured zone: Sera's hands clench, jaw set. Kael folds into himself. Torin relaxes.
closing_hook: They leave the zone. The lattice snaps back — the relief is immediate and physical. Ben looks at Torin and sees someone who is already planning to come back.
emotional_trajectory: Group distress -> focus on Torin's anomalous calm -> deep unease on departure

stakes.personal: Ben's pattern recognition firing — Torin's peace in the breach echoes the Jacen memory Desh named the scene before
stakes.interpersonal: The group has seen Torin's true relationship with de-structuring. It cannot be unseen.
stakes.external: If the wound opens fully, this is what the galaxy feels

setting: Breach Zone — deep inside the de-structured area, then retreat to the perimeter
sensory_details: The lattice returning on exit with the relief of warmth after cold; Torin's face changing as the group leaves — the peace draining slowly, replaced by a weight that was not there before Kolven; Sera's expression on Torin, the look of someone watching a forecast become weather
action_beats: Sera clenches her fists and sets her jaw — holding discipline as a physical act against the formless Force
Kael folds into a survival crouch, ancient and instinctive, his Force presence pulling inward
Torin smiles and spreads his arms slightly — his Force presence expanding where everyone else's contracts
notes: Torin's smile is the load-bearing image of the midpoint. Keep it specific and human — not villainous, not dark-side. Recognition. Relief. A man feeling something he has been missing for a thousand years. The horror is in its normalcy. Torin's arc shifts deeper — the breach confirms his memory of the technique's beauty. Diagnostic-voice trap — Ben should not, in this scene, articulate the Jacen parallel in interiority. The recognition is a flash; the word 'Jacen' belongs to Chapter 18. Write Ben's recognition as a body-response (a cold that lives below the sternum, a step he does not take toward Torin) and trust the reader to hold the echo. Maetha's 'replaces you' should surface once in Ben's memory, fragment only, not in quotation.
